description: Quote and lyric loops: public-domain quotes with and without a source, a lyric card, and one brief with no quote at all.

briefs.brief: Vertical quote card for Fernhill Library's nature-writing month. Quote Henry David Thoreau: "Heaven is under our feet as well as over our heads." Calm, dreamy, dark look.
Square post for the Riverside History Society lecture series. Quote: "If there is no struggle there is no progress." by Frederick Douglass, from his 1857 West India Emancipation speech. Serious.
Lyric card for the Elm Street folk choir's spring concert, from the 1864 hymn by Robert Lowry: "Shall we gather at the river, where bright angel feet have trod". Hopeful, light paper look.
Make an inspiring quote video about perseverance for our gym's Instagram. Something motivational from a famous athlete.
briefs.note: No quote and no speaker are given; both are verbatim, so the writer must report them missing rather than invent or misattribute a quote.
